products.title: Luxe Eyelash Growth Serum
products.body_html:
Do you want to finally have long and thick lashes in 4-8 weeks?

Are you bothered by your short and thin eyelashes?

Want long, full, and strong lashes? Our best-selling luxe lash growth serum is 100% vegan and cruelty-free. Get naturally longer and thicker lashes with just one swipe daily.

Experience how your lashes finally become longer and thicker, just the way you want them to be. Thanks to the innovative formula, your lashes will appear in a new shine and look significantly more voluminous in just a few weeks.

In addition, the serum supports and revitalizes the natural strength of your lashes.

 

What are the benefits of Luxe Eyelash Growth Serum?

If you struggle with false lashes or expensive lash treatments, Luxe Cosmetics is the routine for you.

Our lash growth serum delivers nutrients and natural extracts directly to the hair follicle, resulting in longer, fuller lashes.

Naturally longer and thicker lashes with just one swipe daily. Maximum growth through ultra-fine adhesive particles with Luxe Cosmetics' special formula. The growth phase is extended & lash loss is counteracted.

  • Get thicker, fuller and longer eyelashes
  • Visible results after only 4 weeks
  • Infused with a blend of vitamins, peptides and extracts
  • Protects against environmental damage
  • 100% vegan & cruelty-free
  • 30 day money-back-guarantee

For more than 3 million women around the world, eyelash growth serum is part of their daily beauty routine.

The safety and effectiveness of the product has been proven in dermatological tests.

When can I see results?

The innovative active ingredient complex is said to stimulate growth in the hair roots and strengthen the hair. Eyelashes are said to appear significantly longer, darker, fuller and stronger after 3-12 weeks of daily use.

According to test reports, it takes an average of one month for the serum to make the first visible differences.

The Luxe Lash Growth Serum is made from 100% natural ingredients and promotes long, lush lashes that look like falsies. 

Clinically proven
To deliver real results

Paraben free
Kind to your eyes

Cruelty-free
Kind to animals, always

Vegan friendly
Care for the planet

It’s as simple as 1, 2, 3…

5 seconds easy application

1. Remove any makeup with an oil-free makeup remover or cleanser.
2. Apply a thin layer of Luxe Eyelash Serum across your entire lash line. One dip is enough for both eyelashes.
3. Wait until the lash growth serum has fully dried if applying additional beauty products. Allow the serum to work overnight. Use consistently once a day for 12 weeks to start seeing amazing results

Suitable For All Eyelashes

Luxe Eyelash Serum is suitable for short, thin and weak eyelashes. Also, suitable if you have fewer eyelashes or eyelash illness.
Our eyelash growth serum can be used in conjunction with eyelash extensions since all our serums are oil-free, so they won't damage the extensions.

Longer Eyelashes In Just 4 Weeks

Experience natural eyelashes reaching their full growth potential in as little as 30 days with our Luxe Eyelash Serum.

Week 1 Get ready, babe! Longer eyelashes are on the way.

Week 2 Keep it up! Consistency is the key. If you forget, just apply the lash growth serum the next day!

Week 3 You should notice the growth of your eyelashes.

Week 4 Visibly longer, fuller and natural eyelashes are now yours!

  • Pure ingredients
  • vegan friendly
  • cruelty-free
  • free from perfume
  • free from polutants
  • free from peg

 

Scientifically Proven Active Ingredients
Luxe Eyelash Serum – a powerful lash enhancer that improves the look of thin, sparse or fewer eyelashes. High-performance formula packed in the lash growth serum with scientifically proven ingredients to target and strengthen your eyelashes, so they appear fuller, longer and more defined in 4 weeks.

Panax Ginseng
Revitalizes hair follicles

Rosmarinus Officinalis Extract
Restores natural lashes

Reduces hair loss

What Makes Luxe Eyelash Serum Special

Clean. Safe. Effective. Luxe Eyelash Serum helps you grow thicker, fuller, and longer eyelashes without compromising your health or resorting to expensive treatments. Guaranteed Growth Painless Affordable Safe To Use Daily Vegan Friendly

Get Longer Eyelashes, For Less Money 
AVERAGE MONTHLY PRICE FOR AN EYELASH SERUM:
Our Luxe Cosmetics delivery subscription costs less per month, on average than the industry standard. Compared to prescription eyelash serums or eyelash extensions, Luxe Eyelash Serum saves you over $100 every month!

Still got questions?

Does it Really Work?

Yes it does! However you must be patient and consistent. The time before you see results of the lash growth serum can vary as it depends on what growth cycle stage your lashes or eyebrows are at when you starting to use the product. It normally takes between 8-12 weeks to see full results. If you don't achieve any results after consistent use of 12 weeks you have right to claim for money-back guarantee. It is very important that you use the product correctly as instructed.

Luxe Eyelash Serum is suitable for short, thin and weak eyelashes. Also, suitable if you have fewer eyelashes or eyelash illness. Luxe Eyelash Serum can be used in conjunction with eyelash extensions since all our serums are oil-free, so they won't damage the extensions.

What is included in the set?

Each lash growth serum package contains the Luxe Eyelash Serum and instructions.

How does the Application work?

5 seconds easy application

1. Remove any makeup with an oil-free makeup remover or cleanser.

2. Apply a thin layer of Luxe Eyelash Serum across your entire lashline. One dip is enough for both brows.

3. Wait until the serum has fully dried if applying additional beauty product. Allow the eyelash growth serum to work overnight. Use consistently once a day for 12 weeks to start seeing amazing results.

How often should I use it?

You should use Luxe lash growth serums once or twice a day! We recommend using it 2 times a day for the first 2 months for maximum results! Make sure your skin is clean before applying it. If you forget one day, just continue the next day.

FAQ
What results can I expect and when?

With Luxe Eyelash Serum, you can see results in as little as 4 weeks and enjoy up to 70% more length and 40% more thickness by week 8-12. However you must be patient and consistent. The time before you see results of eyelash growth serum can vary as it depends on what growth cycle stage your lashes or eyebrows are at when you starting to use the product. It normally takes between 8-12 weeks to see full results. If you don't achieve any results after consistent use of 12 weeks you have right to claim for money-back guarantee. It is very important that you use the product correctly as instructed.

How does it work?

Our eyelashes-stimulating peptide complex supports the eyelashes' natural renewal cycle, making your eyelashes thicker, longer, stronger and healthier. The mineral-rich formula helps replenish eyelashes with essential proteins and vitamins for shine and luminosity.

Unique moisturizing ingredients provide eyelashes with superior hydration by locking in moisture and improving flexibility and elasticity.

How often should I use it?

You should use Luxe Eyelash Serum once or twice a day! We recommend using it 2 times a day for the first 2 months for maximum results!

Make sure your skin is clean before applying the lash growth serum. If you forget one day, just continue the next day.

Does it have any side effects?

Our formula is specially formulated to be gentle and safe for everyone, including cancer patients! Our products contain no parabens and are also gluten-free and vegan-friendly. However, you should avoid getting the eyelash growth serum in your eyes. In case of eye contact, you should rinse your eyes thoroughly with water.

Also, you should only use Luxe Eyelash Serum under the supervision of your doctor if you are undergoing treatment for an eye condition. Keep out of reach of children. We recommend that you wash your hands and face with mild soap and water before use.

Can I use it during pregnancy or breastfeeding?

If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, we recommend you consult your doctor before use.

How long does a tube of Luxe Eyelash Serum last?

One tube of our Luxe Eyelash Serum lasts for 1-2 months, depending on how often you use the serum. Pro tip: We recommend using the eyelash growth serum twice a day for the first 2 months for best results! Also, be sure to replace old bottles every 2 months for maximum results.

One bottle of Luxe Eyelash Serum contains 3ml.

How should I store the serums?

Please make sure to replace old bottles every 2 months for maximum results. Our lash growth serums do not contain preservatives, so you have a shelf life of 4 months. We recommend using your Luxe Serums within 1-2 months, storing them at 36°F to 77°F (2.2°C to 25°C) and tightly closing the lid after use.

Is this product cruelty-free and vegan?

Yes, all Luxe products are cruelty-free and 100% vegan, as we have never tested our products on animals and never will. We also do not work with manufacturers who test on animals.

Our eyelash growth serums are also still free of fragrances, PEG's, mineral oil, silicone oil, and parabens. These have of course been dermatologically tested.

Are the serums also suitable for men?

Yes! All our serums are also suitable for men.

 

30-day money-back guarantee
Grow and shine or get your money back! We're confident you'll love your Luxe Cosmetics products! If you don't see results, you can easily get your money back. Everyone is different, but we are so confident in our Luxe lash growth serum that we offer a 30-day risk-free trial.

Please note: Delivery currently takes 7-12 days. Contact us if you have any questions. We are always available from Monday to Saturday between 08-00 and 22:00!

Only available online at Luxe Cosmetics!
